zh.title: CMA 与房屋价值分析
zh.seo_title: CMA 与房屋价值分析｜陈靖
zh.description: CMA 是什么，和 appraisal、网站估值有什么不同？本文讲买方如何选可比成交、分组比较、逐项调整并得出价格区间，以及单价、面积和跨边界比较的常见错误，CMA 不是正式估价。
zh.lead: 挂牌价只是卖方的策略。用可比成交得出一个区间，再决定你的出价。

en.title: CMA and Home Value Analysis for Buyers
en.seo_title: CMA and Home Value Analysis for Buyers | Jing Chen
en.description: What a CMA is, how it differs from an appraisal or portal estimate, and how to choose comparables and reach a price range before you make an offer.
en.lead: A list price is a strategy. Use comparable sales to reach a range, then decide what you're willing to pay.
